raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  name: cloudstorage
  version: 0.11.0
  python_min: "3.9"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/scottwernervt/cloudstorage/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.zip
  sha256: c624eb217a67c8c477b4951ddb41a66ebe5d93644b5f8f60c14c09cabecfb021
  patches:
    - setup.patch

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: python -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}
    - pip
    - setuptools
    - pytest-runner
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - inflection >=0.3.1
    - python-dateutil >=2.7.3
    - python-magic >=0.4.15

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - cloudstorage
        - cloudstorage.drivers
      pip_check: true
      python_version: ${{ python_min }}

about:
  summary: Unified cloud storage API for storage services.
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  homepage: https://github.com/scottwernervt/cloudstorage/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - hadim
